name: Einfache Rolle
summary: A sealed scroll bearing Dannal Stern’s mark reaches you while you deal with the Scourge. It calls you to Deathknell, where Dannal speaks of your freedom and offers to teach you.

sections.title: A Sealed Message
sections.body: While you were away dealing with the mindless Scourge, a scroll arrived for you. Its seal appears to be Dannal Stern’s, the warrior trainer in Deathknell. You are asked to read it and speak with him before setting out again.

sections.title: Freedom and Training
sections.body: Dannal says others escaped death and fled to town, and he sees promise in their resilience. He credits Sylvanas with freeing you in body and spirit, though the plague still afflicts you. He offers to teach you as you gain experience, and says Sylvanas will need people of your class to help save the Forsaken.

faq.answer: The scroll bears the seal of Dannal Stern, the warrior trainer in Deathknell.
It asks you to read it and speak with Dannal Stern in Deathknell.

faq.q: What does Dannal say about Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Dannal credits Sylvanas with freeing you in body and spirit, though the plague still affects you.
Dannal offers to teach you as you gain experience and invites you to seek him out.

faq.q: What does Sylvanas need from me?
faq.answer: Dannal says Sylvanas will need people of your class to help save the Forsaken.
